message.content: {"caption":"Two-panel line chart comparing Solve and Propose rewards and token lengths over training steps for the abduction task.","description":"A two-panel line chart with training steps on the horizontal axis (0–280) and separate colored series: Solve in blue-purple and Propose in salmon. The left panel plots Reward, with a vertical scale from 0 to about 0.9. Solve rises quickly to around 0.65 near steps 50–70, stays mostly near 0.5 through about step 170, peaks at roughly 0.83 near step 190, then fluctuates sharply and finishes below 0.4. Propose rises more gradually to around 0.4 by roughly steps 140–170, falls to about 0.17 near step 190, then rebounds and oscillates, reaching around 0.6 at several points before ending near 0.5. The right panel plots Token Length against the same training-step range, with a vertical scale marked in thousands. Solve remains low through roughly step 60, rises to about 1,000–1,500 tokens around steps 120–170, falls back, then surges to nearly 4,000 near step 235; after another drop it ends around 3,000. Propose begins higher, with an early bump, then stays comparatively low and nearly flat for most of training, briefly dipping close to the bottom around steps 230–240 before returning to its usual range. Values below are estimated from the plotted lines at the labeled x-axis ticks; they are not printed point
